verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Chant And Meditate:
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing that He seems so very far away.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਾਦਰਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਦਾ ਦੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: People beg and pray, "Give to us, give to us", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Those who serve Him are honored.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਭਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Guru has given me this one understanding:
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Guru has given me this one understanding:
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਵਲ ਆਕਾਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless thieves and embezzlers.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਚੋਰ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless impose their will by force.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਮਰ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਲਵਢ ਹਤਿਆ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless sinners who keep on sinning.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਮਲੇਛ ਮਲੁ ਭਖਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੮॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Countless names, countless places.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵ ਅਸੰਖ ਥਾਵ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਲੋਅ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰੀ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬਾਣਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: As He ordains, so do we receive.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ਤਿਵ ਤਿਵ ਪਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਤਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Without Your Name, there is no place at all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: How can I describe Your Creative Power?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੯॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰੀਐ ਹਥੁ ਪੈਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: water can wash away the dirt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਧੋਤੈ ਉਤਰਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਤ ਪਲੀਤੀ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: soap can wash them clean.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਸਾਬੂਣੁ ਲਈਐ ਓਹੁ ਧੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰੀਐ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਆਖਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: You shall harvest what you plant.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤਪੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: -these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਭਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਆਥਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਰਮਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਲਖ ਆਗਾਸਾ ਆਗਾਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: -the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Many struggle to know His limits,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: but His limits cannot be found.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No one can know these limits.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Highest of the High, above all is His Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਊਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Only one as Great and as High as God
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: can know His Lofty and Exalted State.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਚੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨੪॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Great Giver does not hold back anything.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਅਪਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਖਪਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਦ ਮਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਭਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No one else has any say in this.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If some fool should presume to say that he does,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਇਕੁ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇਤੀਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He Himself knows, He Himself gives.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿ ਭਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੫॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਮੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਮੁਲ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲ ਭਾਇ ਅਮੁਲਾ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਤੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮੁਲੋ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਆਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The scholars speak and lecture.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਬਰਮੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਇੰਦ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Gopis and Krishna speak.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਤੈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਈਸਰ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿਧ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The many created Buddhas speak.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਬੁਧ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਆਖਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Many speak and try to describe Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If He were to create as many again as there already are,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: even then, they could not describe Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He is as Great as He wishes to be.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If anyone presumes to describe God,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬੋਲੁਵਿਗਾੜੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਣੁ ਲੋਇ ਲੋਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਚੁਪੈ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No power to beg, no power to give.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No power to live, no power to die.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No power to find the way to escape from the world.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੩॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: wind, water, fire and the nether regions
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: -in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Their names are uncounted and endless.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਓਥੈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੪॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਹੋ ਧਰਮੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਆਖਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਚੰਡੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰੂਪੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: These things cannot be described.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: No one else dwells there,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੀਤੋ ਸੀਤਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Their beauty cannot be described.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Neither death nor deception comes to those,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: within whose minds the Lord abides.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਅ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: As He commands, so they exist.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩੭॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਦੁ ਹਥੀਆਰੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖਲਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਭਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਢਾਲਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਟਕਸਾਲ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩੮॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Shalok:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥

verses.book: Jap Ji Sahib (Song Of The Soul)
verses.text: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧

verses.text: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

verses.text: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥

verses.text: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥

verses.text: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥

verses.text: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥

verses.text: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥

verses.text: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥

verses.text: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.text: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Aasaa, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੈ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥

verses.text: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥

verses.text: All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥

verses.text: The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਹਾਈ ॥

verses.text: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥

verses.text: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥

verses.text: all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥

verses.text: -without You, no one has attained such powers.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥

verses.text: They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: What can the poor helpless creatures do?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥

verses.text: Aasaa, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੂਖ ॥

verses.text: that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤੁ ਭੂਖੈ ਖਾਇ ਚਲੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥

verses.text: How can I forget Him, O my mother?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥

verses.text: people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥

verses.text: He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥

verses.text: This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਏਹੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: The One who created the day also created the night.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥

verses.text: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: O humble servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being: I offer my humble prayer to You, O Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: I am a mere insect, a worm. O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be merciful, and bless me with the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥

verses.text: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the Holy Congregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essence is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shines forth. ||4||4||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥

verses.text: Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Why, O mind, do you plot and plan, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: From rocks and stones He created living beings; He places their nourishment before them. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Dear Lord of souls, one who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained, and the dry wood blossoms forth again in lush greenery. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Mothers, fathers, friends, children and spouses-no one is the support of anyone else.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: For each and every person, our Lord and Master provides sustenance. Why are you so afraid, O mind? ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਊਡੇ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਵਣੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: All the nine treasures, and the eighteen supernatural powers are held by our Lord and Master in the Palm of His Hand.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥

verses.text: Raag Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, So Purakh ~ That Primal Being:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ

verses.text: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

verses.text: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥

verses.text: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥

verses.text: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥

verses.text: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥

verses.text: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥

verses.text: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥

verses.text: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥

verses.text: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥

verses.text: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥

verses.text: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥

verses.text: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
