verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥

verses.text: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥

verses.text: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥

verses.text: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥

verses.text: Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥

verses.text: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥

verses.text: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥

verses.text: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥

verses.text: You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥

verses.text: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥

verses.text: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥

verses.text: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: All belong to You, all meditate on you.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥

verses.text: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

verses.text: You are the River of Life; all are within You.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: There is no one except You.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: All living beings are Your playthings.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥

verses.text: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥

verses.text: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥

verses.text: Those who serve You find peace.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: There is no one except You.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥

verses.text: Aasaa, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥

verses.text: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥

verses.text: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥

verses.text: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੩॥

verses.text: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: This human body has been given to you.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥

verses.text: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥

verses.text: Nothing else will work.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥

verses.text: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥

verses.text: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥

verses.text: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੪॥

verses.text: Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧

verses.text: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

verses.text: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥

verses.text: -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥

verses.text: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥

verses.text: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥

verses.text: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥

verses.text: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ॥

verses.text: and the various seasons originate from the one sun;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੨॥

verses.text: Raag Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Upon that cosmic plate of the sky, the sun and the moon are the lamps. The stars and their orbs are the studded pearls.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥

verses.text: The fragrance of sandalwood in the air is the temple incense, and the wind is the fan. All the plants of the world are the altar flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥

verses.text: What a beautiful Aartee, lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of Fear, this is Your Ceremony of Light.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥

verses.text: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad is the vibration of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: You have thousands of eyes, and yet You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms, and yet You do not have even one.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋੁਹੀ ॥

verses.text: You have thousands of Lotus Feet, and yet You do not have even one foot. You have no nose, but you have thousands of noses. This Play of Yours entrances me. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: By this Illumination, that Light is radiant within all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Light shines forth.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: That which is pleasing to Him is the lamp-lit worship service. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: My mind is enticed by the honey-sweet Lotus Feet of the Lord. Day and night, I thirst for them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥

verses.text: Bestow the Water of Your Mercy upon Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, so that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥

verses.text: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: The body-village is filled to overflowing with anger and sexual desire; these were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥

verses.text: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥

verses.text: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the Taste of the Lord's Sublime Essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥

verses.text: The more they walk away, the deeper it pierces them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥

verses.text: They have found the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they receive great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I am poor and meek, God, but I belong to You! Save me-please save me, O Greatest of the Great!
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥

verses.text: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥

verses.text: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥

verses.text: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥

verses.text: This life is diminishing, day and night. Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਾਰੇ ॥ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥

verses.text: Only those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this Sublime Essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥

verses.text: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts, O Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥

verses.text: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥

verses.text: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

verses.text: Raag Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥

verses.text: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਊਸਰਹਿ ਰਤਨੀ ਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਸਤੂਰਿ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਰਿ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਲੀਪਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed was encased with rubies,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਤੀ ਪਲਘਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: and if heavenly beauties, their faces adorned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਈ ਰਿਧਿ ਆਖਾ ਆਉ ॥

verses.text: and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥

verses.text: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਉ ॥

verses.text: issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puff of wind.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||4||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥

verses.text: and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸਉਣ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥

verses.text: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord, please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill and ground into flour,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਣਿ ਪੀਸਾ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੀਆ ਭਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇ ਭਵਾ ਸੈ ਅਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਵਊ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੀਆ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਗਦ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭਾਉ ॥

verses.text: and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਚਲਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||4||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consume their food.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਉ ॥

verses.text: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਾਉ ॥

verses.text: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholars about this? ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਨਾ ਧੋਹੁ ॥

verses.text: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low. Why should he try to compete with the great?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਨੀਚੀ ਹੂ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੀਸ ॥

verses.text: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥੪॥੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਠਗਿ ਖਾਧਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ॥

verses.text: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of the fragrance of sandalwood,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜਾਣ ॥

verses.text: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿ ਕਹਣ ਵਖਾਣ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਅਵਰ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਕਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਦਾਨਿ ਨ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੁ ਗਲੋਲਾ ਕੂੜ ਕਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਫੀਆ ਰਾਖਣ ਕਉ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਗੁੜ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥

verses.text: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Baba, write such an account,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥

verses.text: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥

verses.text: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥

verses.text: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥

verses.text: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The blackness of sin is erased by my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥

verses.text: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥

verses.text: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥

verses.text: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥

verses.text: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥

verses.text: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful. Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥

verses.text: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥

verses.text: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥

verses.text: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥

verses.text: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥

verses.text: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥

verses.text: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥

verses.text: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?"
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣੀਂ ॥

verses.text: We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥

verses.text: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad."||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥

verses.text: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥

verses.text: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥

verses.text: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥

verses.text: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥

verses.text: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥

verses.text: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥

verses.text: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥

verses.text: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥

verses.text: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥

verses.text: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥

verses.text: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥

verses.text: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥

verses.text: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥

verses.text: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥

verses.text: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥

verses.text: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥

verses.text: -still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, He will not feel satisfied. without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥

verses.text: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥

verses.text: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥

verses.text: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥

verses.text: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥

verses.text: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥

verses.text: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥

verses.text: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥

verses.text: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥

verses.text: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.text: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥

verses.text: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
