verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥

verses.text: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥

verses.text: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Buy that object which will go along with you.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥

verses.text: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥

verses.text: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥

verses.text: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥

verses.text: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥

verses.text: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥

verses.text: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥

verses.text: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥

verses.text: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥

verses.text: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥

verses.text: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥

verses.text: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥

verses.text: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥

verses.text: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥

verses.text: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥

verses.text: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣ ਸਹਿ ਗਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥

verses.text: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥

verses.text: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥

verses.text: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥

verses.text: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Death, O Mullah-death will come,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ॥

verses.text: so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਹੁ ਡਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥

verses.text: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥

verses.text: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥

verses.text: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥

verses.text: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥

verses.text: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥

verses.text: The dogs of greed are with me.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸੁਆਨੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਭਉਕਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਇਆਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੁਰਾ ਮੁਠਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥

verses.text: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਿਗੜੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥

verses.text: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਆਖਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥

verses.text: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥

verses.text: I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਲੂਕੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥

verses.text: I am a robber-I rob the world.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਠਗਵਾੜਾ ਠਗੀ ਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.text: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੁ ॥

verses.text: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੨੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥

verses.text: There is one awareness among all created beings.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ॥

verses.text: None have been created without this awareness.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਅ ॥

verses.text: As is their awareness, so is their way.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥

verses.text: how can You become angry with them?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥

verses.text: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥

verses.text: still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਓਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਓਹਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੀ ਬੋਲਵਿਗਾੜ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਬੋਲ ॥

verses.text: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥

verses.text: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: They are self-realized; they understand God.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥

verses.text: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥

verses.text: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥

verses.text: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥

verses.text: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਹਉ ਖਾਉ ॥

verses.text: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Nanak offers this one prayer:
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥

verses.text: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥

verses.text: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥

verses.text: Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ॥

verses.text: The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਆਰਾਉ ॥

verses.text: -according to their nature, He gives them all their names.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲੁ ਭਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਚੀ ਕੰਧ ਕਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜੁ ॥

verses.text: The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਣੇ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev

verses.text: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥

verses.text: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥

verses.text: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil, and let the Fear of God be the wick for the lamp of this body.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥ ਭਉ ਵਟੀ ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥

verses.text: Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਆਣਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Use this oil to light this lamp.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਇਉ ਜਲੈ ॥

verses.text: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥

verses.text: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥

verses.text: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: In the midst of this world, do seva,
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥

verses.text: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥

verses.text: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||
verses.author: Guru Nanak Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧

verses.text: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

verses.text: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥

verses.text: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥

verses.text: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥

verses.text: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥

verses.text: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥

verses.text: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥

verses.text: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥

verses.text: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥

verses.text: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥

verses.text: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਾਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥

verses.text: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥

verses.text: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥

verses.text: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਪਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥

verses.text: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥

verses.text: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥

verses.text: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥

verses.text: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥

verses.text: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥

verses.text: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥

verses.text: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.text: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥

verses.text: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥

verses.text: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace. His arrogant pride is banished from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤ ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
