verses.text: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, give up the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਦਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥

verses.text: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥

verses.text: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: -they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Consider the time and the moment-when should we worship the Lord?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥

verses.text: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Without the Guru, the disease is not cured, and the pain of egotism is not removed.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, He dwells in the mind, and one remains immersed in His Name.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found; without the Shabad, people wander, deceived by doubt. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, dwell in the balanced state of your own inner being.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Praise the Lord's Name, and you shall no longer come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The One Lord alone is the Giver, pervading everywhere. There is no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Praise the Word of the Shabad, and He shall come to dwell in your mind; you shall be blessed with intuitive peace and poise.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Everything is within the Lord's Glance of Grace. As He wishes, He gives. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: In egotism, all must account for their actions. In this accounting, there is no peace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਾ ਗਣਤ ਹੈ ਗਣਤੈ ਨਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: Acting in evil and corruption, people are immersed in corruption.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: Without the Name, they find no place of rest. In the City of Death, they suffer in agony. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Body and soul all belong to Him; He is the Support of all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, understanding comes, and then the Door of Liberation is found.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has no end or limitation. ||4||24||57||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Those who have the Support of the True Name are in ecstasy and peace forever.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they obtain the True One, the Destroyer of pain.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, He bestows the treasure of devotion. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, sing His Glorious Praises, and be in ecstasy forever.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the True Word of His Bani, the Lord is obtained, and one remains immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: In true devotion, the mind is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love, with intuitive peace and poise.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The mind is fascinated by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, which cannot be described.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The tongue imbued with the True Word of the Shabad drinks in the Amrit with delight, singing His Glorious Praises.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh obtains this love, when the Lord, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: This world is an illusion; people pass their life-nights sleeping.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥

verses.text: By the Pleasure of His Will, He lifts some out, and unites them with Himself.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He Himself abides in the mind, and drives out attachment to Maya.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He Himself bestows glorious greatness; He inspires the Gurmukh to understand. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The One Lord is the Giver of all. He corrects those who make mistakes.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਲਏ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He Himself has deceived some, and attached them to duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਛਡਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is found, and one's light merges into the Light.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Attuned to the Name of the Lord night and day, O Nanak, you shall be absorbed into the Name. ||4||25||58||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The virtuous obtain Truth; they give up their desires for evil and corruption.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Their minds are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Love of their Beloved is on their tongues.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥

verses.text: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himself ushers them into His Presence. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, He unites us with Himself.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗਣਿ ਰੰਗਿਓਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, but they do not understand.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be able to end my suffering.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains a reputation of Truth.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Him again. ||4||26||59||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himself watches over it.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those who remain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unites them with Himself. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, we contemplate Him.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥

verses.text: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean of demerits.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥

verses.text: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk like that, swinging your arms in joy?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਾਮ ਗਹੇਲੀਏ ਕਿਆ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਇ ॥

verses.text: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face will you show Him?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਂ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spend their life-night?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਅਟੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated from within.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissful peace. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and her hunger does not depart.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she is absorbed in the True One. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering before Him.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਇ ॥

verses.text: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they are absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His Constant Presence. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into the True One. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowing with the treasure of devotion.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥

verses.text: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥

verses.text: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without the Guru, they do not find You.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥

verses.text: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits and administers True Justice.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਓਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ॥

verses.text: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The Righteous Judge of Dharma serves them; blessed is the Lord who adorns them. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: One who eliminates mental wickedness from within the mind, and casts out emotional attachment and egotistical pride,
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਤਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: comes to recognize the All-pervading Soul, and is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Without the True Guru, the self-willed manmukhs do not find liberation; they wander around like lunatics.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਵਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: They do not contemplate the Shabad; engrossed in corruption, they utter only empty words. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: He Himself is everything; there is no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: I speak just as He makes me speak, when He Himself makes me speak.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The Word of the Gurmukh is God Himself. Through the Shabad, we merge in Him.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, remember the Naam; serving Him, peace is obtained. ||4||30||63||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥

verses.text: The world is polluted with the filth of egotism, suffering in pain. This filth sticks to them because of their love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: This filth of egotism cannot be washed away, even by taking cleansing baths at hundreds of sacred shrines.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Performing all sorts of rituals, people are smeared with twice as much filth.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: This filth is not removed by studying. Go ahead, and ask the wise ones. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, coming to the Sanctuary of the Guru, you shall become immaculate and pure.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, but their filth cannot be removed. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: With a polluted mind, devotional service cannot be performed, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be obtained.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The filthy, self-willed manmukhs die in filth, and they depart in disgrace.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and the filth of egotism is dispelled.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Like a lamp lit in the darkness, the spiritual wisdom of the Guru dispels ignorance. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਲੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: I have done this, and I will do that-I am an idiotic fool for saying this!
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹਗੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥

verses.text: I have forgotten the Doer of all; I am caught in the love of duality.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: There is no pain as great as the pain of Maya; it drives people to wander all around the world, until they become exhausted.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace is found, with the True Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to those who meet and merge with the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: This mind is attuned to devotional worship; through the True Word of Gurbani, it finds its own home.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥

verses.text: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਚੇ ਗਾਉ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64||
verses.author: Guru Amar Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, First House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I go and ask my friends, "How can I meet and merge with God?"||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite me with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meet Him.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united me with God. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਢਿ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੀਆ ਜੋ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲ ॥

verses.text: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ॥

verses.text: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਦੁਆਸਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਬੂਡਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਊ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is not obtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥

verses.text: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: In His Kindness, He unites us with Himself, as we follow the Guru, the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੬੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get to taste this essence?
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, "How did you come to meet God?"
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਬੋਲਨੀ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your spiritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdue your ego. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਦਇਆ ਪਈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਚਨੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, are known as great and very fortunate. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, but the unfortunate ones do not taste it.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry in misery.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is the Essence.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥

verses.text: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਚੜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਨਰੁ ਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly, rotting away. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਗਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Emotional attachment to children and spouse is poison; in the end, no one will go along with you as your helper. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Through the Guru's Teachings, some embrace love for the Lord, and are saved. They remain detached and unaffected, and they find the Sanctuary of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remain attached to the Love of the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they are honored at the True Door. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light of the Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70||
verses.author: Guru Ram Das
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੩੧॥੬॥੭੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥

verses.text: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥

verses.text: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ॥

verses.text: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸੀ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਫਾਰ ॥

verses.text: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are only dust.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪੜਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥

verses.text: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੇ ਕੀਏ ਰਥ ਅਥਾਕ ॥

verses.text: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਕ ॥

verses.text: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈਦਾ ਬਦ ਦੁਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕਤ ॥

verses.text: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਅਨਿਤ ॥

verses.text: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ॥

verses.text: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਇਕੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਇ ॥

verses.text: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of his requests are denied.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe. ||4||1||71||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੭੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ॥

verses.text: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਸੇ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

verses.text: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish and anxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਭਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥

verses.text: The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, "This is mine! This is mine!"||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਵਡ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੨॥

verses.text: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced to dust. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door the Siddhas and the Saadhus stand,
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥

verses.text: who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰੰਬਾਰੀ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਬੀ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and without understanding.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਪੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਿ ॥

verses.text: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਛੁਟੈਗੀ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥

verses.text: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣਿ ॥

verses.text: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਗਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੁਫਕੜੇ ਸਭ ਮੁਕਦੀ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਦਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ॥

verses.text: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਓਤੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਭਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it in your mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਘਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਫਾਥੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਿਕਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਇਆ ਕਢਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥

verses.text: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਹ ਡਡੁਰੀ ਪਕੀ ਵਢਣਹਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦਾਤ ਪਹੁਤਿਆ ਲਾਵੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਈਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਦਾ ਤਾ ਲੁਣਿ ਮਿਣਿਆ ਖੇਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes in deep sleep.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਇਆ ॥

verses.text: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਇਆ ਚਉਥੈ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥

verses.text: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥

verses.text: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul to them.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੀਆ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowing Lord God.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥

verses.text: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||4||74||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਡਿਠਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥

verses.text: All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the true object of life.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥

verses.text: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸਭੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਇਕਾ ਆਸ ਕਮਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, praise the Creator.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥

verses.text: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਛਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਛਿਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: No one can kill that one unto whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਥ ਦੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥

verses.text: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਸਕਤੇ ਤੂਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥

verses.text: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਵ ॥

verses.text: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇਵ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਜਣੋ ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤੁ ॥

verses.text: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥

verses.text: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousness becomes steady and stable.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥

verses.text: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one's Support, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਤੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: All things are received if the One is obtained.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਥਿ ॥

verses.text: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Word of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਥਿ ॥

verses.text: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਥਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya is totally false. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭ ਧੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥

verses.text: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ॥

verses.text: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਢੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਭਾ ॥

verses.text: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no old age. ||4||6||76||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਧਾ ਘਰੁ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮਨ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਇੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
