verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, and the noose of death shall be cut away.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥

verses.text: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥

verses.text: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of the High.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥

verses.text: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਇ ॥

verses.text: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਗੈ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: What good is worldly greatness?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਵਨੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ॥

verses.text: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥

verses.text: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥

verses.text: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥

verses.text: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥

verses.text: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਪੁ ॥

verses.text: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਕੋ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਰਾ ਇਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, give up all these efforts.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥

verses.text: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਤ ਇਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ॥

verses.text: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ॥

verses.text: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself is in all places and interspaces.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥

verses.text: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥

verses.text: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੭੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and famous.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥

verses.text: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those unto whom the Lord Himself shows Mercy.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of the Lord. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service to the Lord of the World.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥

verses.text: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure; the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥

verses.text: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord God abides.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥

verses.text: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਹਾਨ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੮੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Meeting the True Guru, all my sufferings have ended, and the Peace of the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥

verses.text: The Divine Light illuminates my inner being, and I am lovingly absorbed in the One.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Meeting with the Holy Saint, my face is radiant; I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. Through the True Name, I have become spotlessly pure. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਣੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, you shall find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Working for the Perfect Guru, no one goes away empty-handed. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is always with you; recognize Him as the Creator.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: By Guru's Grace, your face shall be radiant. Chanting the Naam, you shall receive the benefits of giving charity and taking cleansing baths.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Sexual desire, anger and greed are eliminated, and all egotistical pride is abandoned. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਤਜਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The Profit of the Naam is obtained, and all affairs are brought to fruition.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥

verses.text: In His Mercy, God unites us with Himself, and He blesses us with the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥

verses.text: My comings and goings in reincarnation have come to an end; He Himself has bestowed His Mercy.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: I have obtained my home in the True Mansion of His Presence, realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: His humble devotees are protected and saved; He Himself showers His Blessings upon us.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: In this world and in the world hereafter, radiant are the faces of those who cherish and enshrine the Glories of the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Twenty-four hours a day, they lovingly dwell upon His Glories; they are imbued with His Infinite Love.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਦੇ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God, the Ocean of Peace. ||4||11||81||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the Treasure of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Please grant Your Grace, God, that we may meditate on Your Ambrosial Naam.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥

verses.text: The pains of birth and death are taken away; we are intuitively centered on His Meditation. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, seek the Sanctuary of God.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Without the Lord, there is no other at all. Meditate on the One and only Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: His Value cannot be estimated; He is the Vast Ocean of Excellence.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: O most fortunate ones, join the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation; purchase the True Word of the Shabad.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥

verses.text: Serve the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: I take the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet; there is no other place of rest for me.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥

verses.text: I lean upon You as my Support, O Supreme Lord God. I exist only by Your Power.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: O God, You are the Honor of the dishonored. I seek to merge with You. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Chant the Lord's Name and contemplate the Lord of the World, twenty-four hours a day.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: He preserves our soul, our breath of life, body and wealth. By His Grace, He protects our soul.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, all pain has been washed away, by the Supreme Lord God, the Forgiver. ||4||12||82||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੋਖ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੮੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: I have fallen in love with the True Lord. He does not die, He does not come and go.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: In separation, He is not separated from us; He is pervading and permeating amongst all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: He is the Destroyer of the pain and suffering of the meek. He bears True Love for His servants.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Wondrous is the Form of the Immaculate One. Through the Guru, I have met Him, O my mother! ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O Siblings of Destiny, make God your Friend.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Cursed is emotional attachment and love of Maya; no one is seen to be at peace. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: God is Wise, Giving, Tender-hearted, Pure, Beautiful and Infinite.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੀਲਵੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: He is our Companion and Helper, Supremely Great, Lofty and Utterly Infinite.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: He is not known as young or old; His Court is Steady and Stable.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Whatever we seek from Him, we receive. He is the Support of the unsupported. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Seeing Him, our evil inclinations vanish; mind and body become peaceful and tranquil.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥

verses.text: With one-pointed mind, meditate on the One Lord, and the doubts of your mind will be dispelled.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥

verses.text: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Ever-fresh Being. His Gift is Perfect and Complete.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him. Day and night, do not forget Him. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Lord of the Universe as his Companion.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਖਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all to Him. I totally sacrifice my soul to Him.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੋ ਸਗਲ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਇਹ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: Seeing and hearing, He is always close at hand. In each and every heart, God is pervading.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਸਦ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਵਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: Even the ungrateful ones are cherished by God. O Nanak, He is forever the Forgiver. ||4||13||83||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਨੋ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੩॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: This mind, body and wealth were given by God, who naturally adorns us.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: He has blessed us with all our energy, and infused His Infinite Light deep within us.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God; keep Him enshrined in your heart. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, without the Lord, there is no other at all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Remain in God's Sanctuary forever, and no suffering shall afflict you. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Jewels, treasures, pearls, gold and silver-all these are just dust.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥

verses.text: Mother, father, children and relatives-all relations are false.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਭੇ ਸਾਕ ॥

verses.text: The self-willed manmukh is an insulting beast; he does not acknowledge the One who created him. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਸੁ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The Lord is pervading within and beyond, and yet people think that He is far away.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: They are engrossed in clinging desires; within their hearts there is ego and falsehood.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Without devotion to the Naam, crowds of people come and go. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਆਵਹਿ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Please preserve Your beings and creatures, God; O Creator Lord, please be merciful!
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥

verses.text: Without God, there is no saving grace. The Messenger of Death is cruel and unfeeling.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਜਮ ਭਇਆ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord! ||4||14||84||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੪॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: My body and my wealth; my ruling power, my beautiful form and country-mine!
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਮੈ ਦੇਸੁ ॥

verses.text: You may have children, a wife and many mistresses; you may enjoy all sorts of pleasures and fine clothes.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਵੇਸ ॥

verses.text: And yet, if the Name of the Lord does not abide within the heart, none of it has any use or value. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥

verses.text: Always keep the Company of the Holy, and focus your consciousness on the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads meditate on the Treasure of the Naam.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥

verses.text: All their affairs are brought to fruition, holding onto the Guru's Feet.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥

verses.text: The diseases of ego and doubt are cast out; they shall not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਗੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Let the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, be your cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Your soul, breath of life, mind and body shall blossom forth in lush profusion; this is the true purpose of life.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥

verses.text: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥

verses.text: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥

verses.text: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥

verses.text: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੫॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥

verses.text: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਐ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥

verses.text: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His Ambrosial Glance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, serve the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of demerits.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਟਣਹਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatious displays, I have come to see this.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥

verses.text: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austere self-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥

verses.text: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: True is His Empire, and True is His Command. True is His Seat of True Authority.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਓਨੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||16||86||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੬॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ॥

verses.text: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥

verses.text: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥

verses.text: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed all meditations and austerities. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਭਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing the Glories of God. ||4||17||87||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੭॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes to chant the Name of the Lord.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਸਤੁ ਸਉਣੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, without shelter, have now obtained Shelter.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥

verses.text: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go in reincarnation. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥

verses.text: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as your Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: In the Society of the Saints, God, the Beloved, the Forgiver, comes to dwell within the mind.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥

verses.text: One who has served his God is the emperor of kings||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਜ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ॥੨॥

verses.text: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings the merit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: The tongue which chants these Praises is worthy; there is no charity equal to this.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣਵਤੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: Blessing us with His Glance of Grace, the Kind and Compassionate, All-powerful Lord comes to dwell within the mind and body.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥

verses.text: My soul, body and wealth are His. Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: One whom the Creator Lord has met and joined to Himself shall never again be separated.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The True Creator Lord breaks the bonds of His slave.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: The doubter has been put back on the path; his merits and demerits have not been considered.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the One who is the Support of every heart. ||4||18||88||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੮॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: With your tongue, repeat the True Name, and your mind and body shall become pure.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

verses.text: Your mother and father and all your relations-without Him, there are none at all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਕ ਅਗਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: If God Himself bestows His Mercy, then He is not forgotten, even for an instant. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, serve the True One, as long as you have the breath of life.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Without the True One, everything is false; in the end, all shall perish. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: My Lord and Master is Immaculate and Pure; without Him, I cannot even survive.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Within my mind and body, there is such a great hunger; if only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother!
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: I have searched the four corners of the world-without our Husband Lord, there is no other place of rest. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਸਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru is the Giver of the Naam; His Treasure is perfect and overflowing.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: Forever and ever, praise the One, who has no end or limitation. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Praise God, the Nurturer and Cherisher; His Wondrous Ways are unlimited.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਚਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ॥

verses.text: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him; this is the most wonderful wisdom.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਏਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, God's Flavor is sweet to the minds and bodies of those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads. ||4||19||89||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੯॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: Meet with the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, and contemplate the True Name.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: For the journey of the soul, gather those supplies which will go with you here and hereafter.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤੋਸਾ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: These are obtained from the Perfect Guru, when God bestows His Glance of Grace.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: Those unto whom He is Merciful, receive His Grace. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੌਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, there is no other as great as the Guru.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥

verses.text: I cannot imagine any other place. The Guru leads me to meet the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Those who go to see the Guru obtain all treasures.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Those whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet are very fortunate, O my mother.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru is All-powerful. The Guru is All-pervading, contained amongst all.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God. The Guru lifts up and saves those who are drowning. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਏ ਤਰਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: How shall I praise the Guru, the All-powerful Cause of causes?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥

verses.text: Those, upon whose foreheads the Guru has placed His Hand, remain steady and stable.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਮਥੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਹਥੁ ॥

verses.text: The Guru has led me to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has released me from the cycle of birth and death.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆਲਿਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਪਥੁ ॥

verses.text: I serve the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, the Dispeller of fear; my suffering has been taken away. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਲਥੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: The True Guru is the Deep and Profound Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of sin.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਘਖੰਡੁ ॥

verses.text: For those who serve their Guru, there is no punishment at the hands of the Messenger of Death.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਡੰਡੁ ॥

verses.text: There is none to compare with the Guru; I have searched and looked throughout the entire universe.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ॥

verses.text: The True Guru has bestowed the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, the mind is filled with peace. ||4||20||90||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਡੁ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੯੦॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: People eat what they believe to be sweet, but it turns out to be bitter in taste.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਕਉੜਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥

verses.text: They attach their affections to brothers and friends, uselessly engrossed in corruption.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਦ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ॥

verses.text: They vanish without a moment's delay; without God's Name, they are stunned and amazed. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O my mind, attach yourself to the service of the True Guru.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥

verses.text: Whatever is seen, shall pass away. Abandon the intellectualizations of your mind. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Like the mad dog running around in all directions,
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ਧਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥

verses.text: the greedy person, unaware, consumes everything, edible and non-edible alike.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ ਸਭ ਖਾਇ ॥

verses.text: Engrossed in the intoxication of sexual desire and anger, people wander through reincarnation over and over again. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Maya has spread out her net, and in it, she has placed the bait.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਣਾਇ ॥

verses.text: The bird of desire is caught, and cannot find any escape, O my mother.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪੰਖੀ ਫਾਸਿਆ ਨਿਕਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਇ ॥

verses.text: One who does not know the Lord who created him, comes and goes in reincarnation over and over again. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥

verses.text: By various devices, and in so many ways, this world is enticed.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: They alone are saved, whom the All-powerful, Infinite Lord protects.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ਸੋ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: The servants of the Lord are saved by the Love of the Lord. O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||21||91||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੧॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥

verses.text: The herdsman comes to the pasture lands-what good are his ostentatious displays here?
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡੰਫੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥

verses.text: When your allotted time is up, you must go. Take care of your real hearth and home. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥

verses.text: O mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and serve the True Guru with love.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥

verses.text: Why do you take pride in trivial matters? ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਥੋੜੜੀ ਬਾਤ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Like an overnight guest, you shall arise and depart in the morning.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਸਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: Why are you so attached to your household? It is all like flowers in the garden. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਰਤਾ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਫੁਲਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ ॥੨॥

verses.text: Why do you say, "Mine, mine"? Look to God, who has given it to you.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜਿ ॥

verses.text: It is certain that you must arise and depart, and leave behind your hundreds of thousands and millions. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Through 8.4 million incarnations you have wandered, to obtain this rare and precious human life.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿਆ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਓਇ ॥

verses.text: O Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the day of departure is drawing near! ||4||22||92||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਓਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੨॥

verses.text: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
verses.author: None
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥

verses.text: As long as the soul-companion is with the body, it dwells in happiness.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥

verses.text: But when the companion arises and departs, then the body-bride mingles with dust. ||1||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਾਲਿ ॥੧॥

verses.text: My mind has become detached from the world; it longs to see the Vision of God's Darshan.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥

verses.text: Blessed is Your Place. ||1||Pause||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

verses.text: As long as the soul-husband dwells in the body-house, everyone greets you with respect.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥

verses.text: But when the soul-husband arises and departs, then no one cares for you at all. ||2||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੰਤੜਾ ਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੨॥

verses.text: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, in your in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੁ ॥

verses.text: Meeting with the Guru, be a sincere student of proper conduct, and suffering shall never touch you. ||3||
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੩॥

verses.text: Everyone shall go to their Husband Lord. Everyone shall be given their ceremonial send-off after their marriage.
verses.author: Guru Arjan Dev
verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵੰਞਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੁਕਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥
